architecture_rules: Production Web and Student consume canonical @zoeskoul/curriculum-registry runtime data; do not restore apps/web/src/lib/subjects as production truth.
Canonical learner workspace ownership lives in packages/learner-workspace; Web/Student should remain thin adapters/re-exports where migration established that boundary.
Do not recreate duplicate CodeRunner, IDE, Review, or Practice implementations inside apps/web to satisfy stale tests.
When tests mock Web-local owners that production no longer imports, update tests to the canonical owner or canonical DOM contract.
Keep SQL curriculum identity tests cardinality-independent.
Review/Practice must not introduce browser-local persistence.
Auto-advance remains correct-answer-only and existing attempts policy remains intact.

gates.name: runtime-roots
gates.command: cd apps/web && pnpm exec vitest run src/lib/practice/experience/resolve.test.ts src/components/ide/fullide/chrome/IdeDesktopLayout.singleFile.test.tsx src/components/ide/fullide/chrome/IdeMobileLayout.test.tsx src/components/ide/fullide/panes/IdeEditorPane.test.tsx src/components/review/module/components/layout/ReviewModuleLayout.transition.test.tsx src/components/code/runner/CodeRunner.test.tsx

gates.name: canonical-sql-identity
gates.command: cd apps/web && pnpm exec vitest run src/lib/practice/sqlAnalysisReportingExerciseIdentity.test.ts

gates.name: canonical-manifests
gates.command: if pnpm -s run | grep -q 'check:manifests'; then pnpm run check:manifests; else echo 'canonical_manifest_boundary=SKIPPED_NO_SCRIPT'; fi
